visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @新加坡. [Logo]: HahaTai. [Subtitle]: In Indonesia, I don't really see much old people working. 我真的沒看過多少老人在工作哦. (2) [Subtitle]: I see so many elderly working. 我看到很多老人在工作. (3) [Subtitle]: I don't know how to feel about that. I kinda feel bad. 我覺得有點難過. (4) [Subtitle]: Because from where I came from... 因為我來自那裡. (5) [Subtitle]: The elderly (in Indonesian) are more fragile I think. (印尼的)老人身體比較虛弱. (6) [Subtitle]: For retirement is which age (of Indonesian)? (印尼的)退休年齡是幾歲. (7) [Subtitle]: Around 60 to 70. 大概60到70歲之間. (8) [Subtitle]: But mostly nowadays they are around like 40 to 50. 但現在大多數人是40到50歲. (9) [Subtitle]: because most Indonesian has kids that are already worked. 因為大多數印尼人的孩子已經工作了. (10) [Subtitle]: So they tend to rely on their kid's money more than working for themselves. 所以他們更傾向於依賴孩子而不是自己工作. (11) [Subtitle]: I still have to work in my seventies. 七十幾歲還是要做工的. (12) [Subtitle]: Is there no official retirement age in Singapore? 在新加坡沒有退休的年紀? (13) [Subtitle]: There's just a guideline, like you can work till a certain age. 他只是講說你可以工作到幾歲幾歲. (14) [Subtitle]: but no rule saying you must stop. 沒有講說你不可以幾歲幾歲退休. (15) [Subtitle]: Have you planned when you'll retire? 那你有自己給自己規劃可能幾歲之後... (16) [Subtitle]: Retire? 退休? (17) [Variety]: (開什麼玩笑). (18) [Subtitle]: Yes, no work at all. 對啊退休不要工作了. (19) [Subtitle]: In Singapore, if you can still work you work. 新加坡你可以做工你就是做. (20) [Subtitle]: until you die, or until you can't. 做到你死，做到你不可做為止. (21) [Subtitle]: Then your children help support you? 然後兒子女兒大家一起分擔家計這樣. (22) [Variety]: 很難了啦. (23) [Subtitle]: It's hard nowadays. 很難了啦. (24) [Subtitle]: Singapore is really tough. 現在這個新加坡實在很難了. (25) [Subtitle]: There's no family closeness anymore. 沒有親情在了. (26) [Subtitle]: No family closeness? 沒有親情了? (27) [Subtitle]: Because you raised your kids to grow up. 因為你養大兒子女子. (28) [Subtitle]: They get married, move far away. 嫁的嫁就出去了，遠的遠了. (29) [Subtitle]: have their own family, kids, and responsibility. 他們自己有家庭也有孩子也要負擔. (30) [Variety]: 養兒防老. (31) [Variety]: 沒有了. (32) [Subtitle]: 'raising kids to support you in old age.' That saying doesn't work here anymore in Singapore. No more. 養兒防老，沒有了，新加坡不可以用這句了，沒有這個觀念，沒有了.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video explores the cultural differences in retirement expectations and family dynamics between Indonesia and Singapore through street interviews, highlighting the reality of elderly citizens working in Singapore due to high living costs and changing social structures.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic street-interview format with high-quality audio and subtitles to discuss a sensitive social topic. The contrast between the perspectives of young travelers/residents and a local elderly citizen provides a rounded view of the subject.
